RABINDRA BHARATI UNIVERSITY
56A, B. T. Road, Kolkata -700050
NOTICE
This is for information of all concerned that the "Computer Application Course"
for all the Ph.D Scholars of Arts, Fine Arts and Visual Arts (Session 2024 -
2025) will be organized centrally on and from 15-09-2026. All the concerned
scholars of all the Departments of Arts, Fine Arts and Visual Arts faculty are
requested to meet the undersigned at the Computer Centre on 15-09-2026 at
3.45 p.m.
For any queries contact Computer Centre within office hours / 9831061142.
HODs and Ph.D Course Coordinators are requested to intimate the
concerned Scholars that they can attend the said part of the Course Work.
Dr. Bankim Chandra Mandal
Director
R.B.U. Computer Centre
